name: Leo Crawford
source:
Girl-friendly court bureaucrat.
He has a fluffy atmosphere, but he does his job well and is familiar with various knowledge.
Rumor has it that he sometimes goes to the castle at night because he's playing with a woman ...?

[Taken from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/100puri/chara/100leo_crawford.html]official website[/url]]
